note: Carroll County VA has no adopted county zoning; the county's draft zoning ordinance and map are preliminary and tabled, with no public link. The county's only GIS is the InteractiveGIS parcel viewer (carrollcova.interactivegis.com), with no public ArcGIS REST zoning layer found. Hillsville (ecode360 Ch. 171, Art. VI) has zoning, but its official map is kept on file by the Town Manager, not published as a service. Galax has zoning (ecode360 GA1297) but no GIS zoning layer was found online. ArcGIS Hub/Online searches for Carroll County VA zoning returned nothing.
